crossRefs.note: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter…

people.name: Enoch
people.line: Son of Cain, and a city named after him.

people.name: Irad
people.line: Descendant of Cain; father of Mehujael.

people.name: Lamech
people.line: Descendant of Cain; first polygamist mentioned in the Bible

people.name: Mehujael
people.line: Descendant of Cain; father of Methushael.

people.name: Methushael
people.line: A descendant of Cain; father of Lamech.

translations.web: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
translations.bsb: Now to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methusael, and Methusael was the father of Lamech.
translations.kjv: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
translations.asv: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methushael; and Methushael begat Lamech.
